summary: October 30, 2026 briefing compared with October 28. Battle Deck release day: Target's separate Espeon ex and Umbreon ex listings and TCINs are now directly verified, both showing out of stock. Delta Reign's Target page is readable again and retains the November 6 street date. Walmart's October 28 drawing entry is closed, with results due today; its generic Wednesday queue banner is not a confirmed new dated event. No substantive newly introduced purchase-limit or checkout-rule change was established for October 23–30. Source limitations and unverified tracker/date claims are separated below.

retailers.coverage: Direct official pages read for both Battle Decks, Delta Reign booster display and preorder policy. This resolves the prior edition's Delta Reign fetch failure. Displayed stock is a point-in-time observation, not a guarantee for any location. No item cap or retailer opening hour verified. Marketplace bundles were kept separate.

confirmed.title: Drawing entry locks checkout details and authorizes an order
confirmed.details: An account is required, entry is free, and each drawing permits one entry. Address, payment and quantity cannot be changed after entry; entries cannot be canceled. Selection triggers an automatic order, with charging conditional on successful processing. Existing-cart items cannot join that order. General Walmart caps may apply across person, household, account, payment and address.
confirmed.planningImpact: Verify all details before entry; comply with the drawing and household allowance. These rules remain baseline guidance, not a verified new policy this week.
checks: Read drawing-specific eligibility and caps; no universal Walmart+ requirement was established here.

confirmed.title: Preorder FAQ has mixed wording on combining items
confirmed.details: The FAQ first advises separate orders for multiple preorder items, but a later answer permits combining preorder items with matching release dates. It consistently prohibits mixing preorder and in-stock items. Preorder addresses cannot be changed. The page is dated August 13, so this is clarification of prior coverage, not a newly announced restriction.
confirmed.planningImpact: Use separate preorder orders as a conservative planning choice while checking product-specific guidance; do not describe same-date combination as unconditional. Confirm accurate shipping details and valid payment beforehand.
